description: Implementation of a builder class for creating responses and events related to live command answering in the context of modifying attributes via the Eclipse Ditto framework. Contains nested classes for response and event factories, and methods for constructing response objects based on command outcomes.

classes.name: ModifyAttributeLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl
classes.description: A concrete implementation of a builder for creating responses and events for modifying attributes within a live command context.

classes.name: ResponseFactoryImpl
classes.description: Immutable factory class to create various types of response objects indicating command results or errors.

classes.name: EventFactoryImpl
classes.description: Immutable factory class to create event objects that signal attribute creation or modification.

methods.name: doCreateResponse
methods.description: Creates a command response object using the provided response factory function.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Creates an event object using the provided event factory function.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static method to instantiate a new builder object for a given command.
